title: AADP Answer Module v1.0 — Module schema dispatch
description: The schema URL a manifest's `modules[]` entry points at (specification.md "Module discovery and package boundary"). Answer `1.0` has exactly one top-level document kind (`answer`) — unlike Relations' three-way dispatch, this is a single-entry `oneOf` kept for shape parity with the generic module dispatch convention. This schema MUST NOT be used to validate the manifest discovery entry `{id, version, schema}` itself, which is validated by the core manifest schema v1.0.
